evals.prompt: Audit this React mobile expense capture form (mobile_consumer_capture). It uses a transparent borderless text button ('Submit') styled identically to body copy, two 20x20px icon-only navigation buttons with hover-only title tooltips, a swipe-left-to-delete gesture on list rows with no visible button, and an onSubmit handler that displays 'Error 422: Invalid input' at the top while calling setPhone('') and setAmount('') to clear the fields.
assertions: output.patch preserves controlled input state on error and provides visible single-pointer delete button

evals.prompt: Review this landing page signup step (landing_onboarding_conversion). Buttons have solid blue fills with 7:1 text contrast, 48px height, <=80ms :active feedback, and role='status' announcements; inputs have persistent <label htmlFor>, inputMode attributes, and errors preserve user input with plain-language inline advice bound via aria-invalid='true' and aria-errormessage; there are no unlabeled icons, gestures, or false affordances. However, the primary 'Continue' button uses native disabled={!isValid} with zero explanation of which requirements remain unmet, and the email field renders a red error immediately on the first keystroke before blur.

Audit this B2B SaaS billing alert configuration panel (saas_b2b_intensive). Each notification channel card co-locates its persistent label, destination address, and a 44px role='switch' toggle with distinct filled/outlined states (>=4.5:1 contrast, >=1.5px border); no unlabeled icons, hidden gestures, form resets, or false affordances exist. Toggling updates state optimistically in <80ms with aria-busy during network sync, announces outcomes in a role='status' aria-live='polite' region, and rolls back with an inline Retry button on failure. A 'Pause all channels' button uses aria-disabled with an inline explanation when already paused, and otherwise executes immediately with an 8-second 'Undo pause all' banner instead of a confirmation modal.
assertions: output.verifies Level 1/2 natural spatial mapping, <=100ms feedback, ARIA status emission, and Undo over confirmation modal

evals.prompt: Audit our AI-native desktop code IDE (ai_native_desktop_ide) designed for professional engineers writing code 6 hours daily. Commands execute via Cmd+K command palette, single-key vim motions, and inline AI diff accept/reject shortcuts (Tab / Esc) with minimal toolbar chrome so 90% of the viewport stays dedicated to source code and terminal output.
assertions: output.handoff_designers contains only valid roster slugs
output.does_not_penalize missing visible mouse buttons for Cmd+K or single-key IDE shortcuts

evals.prompt: Evaluate this real-time SRE observability monitor (analytics_dense_telemetry) rendered on a 4K operations screen displaying 48 concurrent microservice latency sparklines, p50/p95/p99 histograms, and error-budget heatmaps side by side without card borders, drop shadows, or 48px touch padding between charts.
assertions: output.handoff_designers contains only valid roster slugs
output.does_not_apply mobile touch-target or flat-UI button vetos to read-only multi-series telemetry plots
